calibration_note: davis2020downregulation Fig. 3C Wistar XE-991-sensitive I_M -4.03 pA/pF x Cm 30 pF (assumed), the deactivation relaxation in a 1 s step from -25 to -55 mV (current after the ohmic jump minus that near the end of the step; davis2021transcriptomic p. 172-173); E_K -96.5 mV (Ki 200 mM, 22 degC); depends on tau_w
comment: Davis et al. 2020 (Hypertension 76:1915), Fig. 3C, and Davis 2021 thesis (Ch. 4, pp. 172-174, Fig. 4.10C), the same data: M-current deactivation protocol in Wistar rat stellate neurons (perforated patch, room temperature): voltage-clamped at -25 mV, then 'a brief 1 second hyperpolarisation to -55 mV'; 'the difference in current following the initial ohmic change, and the steady-state current towards the end of the step' (thesis p. 172-173), of the 10 uM XE-991-sensitive current, normalised to capacitance: Wistar 4.03 pA/pF (median, n = 11). So the datum is the deactivation RELAXATION amplitude at -55 mV (not the steady-state difference between -25 and -55 mV). Protocol here: the channel module alone with its boundary conditions clamped (E_K = -96.4979 mV: Nernst, Ko 4.5 / Ki 200 mM, 295.15 K; A_mem 3000 um^2; T 295.15 K; all from the instance parameters): sub-experiment 0 holds V = -25 mV for 10 s (> 30 tau_w, the steady holding state), sub-experiment 1 steps to V = -55 mV for 1 s, as Davis did. The model's relaxation is mean_in_range_minus_initial on i_M in the step: the mean over its last 10 % (0.9-1.0 s, 'towards the end of the step') minus its first sample (just after the instantaneous ohmic change; the gate w is continuous, V jumps). Not corrected for the uncorrected liquid junction potential (24.3 mV, Davis 2019 bioRxiv Methods), as in the source. To redo: edit this file and run venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_modules.py --component i_M/Argus2026_v01 -k 'calibrate and davis2020_wistar' --include-unreviewed (rewrites davis2020_wistar_calibrated_parameters.json and _calibration.json)

experiment_labels: davis2020downregulation deactivation: hold -25 mV, 1 s step to -55 mV

data_items.comment: davis2020downregulation Fig. 3C, Wistar: XE-991-sensitive M-current density -4.032 pA/pF (median, n = 11; the sign: the outward current decreases during the step), converted to a current with an ASSUMED cell capacitance Cm = 30 pF (not reported by Davis; the SN model's soma capacitance): -4.032 pA/pF x 30 pF = -120.96 pA = -0.12096 nA. std: the error bar of Fig. 3C, digitised (the 11 Wistar points give mean -3.90, SD 1.12, SEM 0.34 pA/pF, which is what the bar shows, although the legend says median +- IQR): 0.34 pA/pF x 30 pF = 0.0102 nA. Model value: mean(i_M over the last 10 % of the 1 s step) - i_M(first sample of the step).
